findings.title: SECURITY.md Protected Paths glob does not cover docs/decisions/*.md
findings.detail: The CODEOWNERS and protected-paths workflow protect root spec files and .husky/, .github/, .claude/ but docs/decisions/*.md (accepted ADRs) is not listed. The pre-commit hook blocks edits to accepted ADRs, but the merge-time gate has no glob for this path. A human could merge a branch that edits an accepted ADR without CODEOWNERS review.
findings.fix_sketch: Add docs/decisions/*.md to SECURITY.md Protected Paths and to .github/CODEOWNERS. Requires operator review per AGENTS.md §7.
